title.en: The Theoretical Structure of Machine Learning

description.zh-CN: 一份连续的中文理论课件，从学习问题与经验风险出发，推导损失函数、梯度下降和反向传播，再讨论核方法、支持向量机与泛化。以定义、推导、成立条件和概念联系组织讲解。
description.en: One continuous theoretical presentation in Chinese: from the learning problem and empirical risk to losses, gradient descent, backpropagation, kernel methods, support vector machines and generalization. The discussion is organized around definitions, derivations, assumptions and connections.

summary.zh-CN: 输入、目标、假设空间、归纳偏置，以及总体风险与经验风险的区别。
summary.en: Inputs, targets, hypothesis spaces, inductive bias, and the distinction between population and empirical risk.

summary.zh-CN: 从条件似然推导平方误差与交叉熵，明确分数、概率、决策和梯度。
summary.en: Derive squared error and cross-entropy from conditional likelihood, distinguishing scores, probabilities, decisions and gradients.

summary.zh-CN: 用一阶近似和下降引理解释负梯度、步长条件、随机梯度与收敛边界。
summary.en: Use first-order approximations and the descent lemma to explain negative gradients, step sizes, stochastic gradients and convergence conditions.

summary.zh-CN: 沿计算图推导仿射层、激活层与完整梯度递推，区分求导和参数更新。
summary.en: Derive affine and activation layer gradients and the full recurrence through a computation graph; distinguish differentiation from parameter updates.

title.en: Kernel methods and support vector machines

summary.zh-CN: 从内积、半正定性和样本空间分解，走向核技巧、范数正则与 SVM 对偶。
summary.en: Develop kernel computation, norm regularization and the SVM dual from inner products, positive semidefiniteness and the sample-span decomposition.

summary.zh-CN: 区分逼近、估计与优化的影响，讨论一致偏差界、正则化与独立评价。
summary.en: Distinguish approximation, estimation and optimization, and discuss uniform deviation bounds, regularization and independent evaluation.

summary.zh-CN: 以 softmax、交叉熵和概率链式分解连接后续语言模型学习。
summary.en: Connect the framework to language models through softmax, cross-entropy and the probability chain rule.

subtitle.zh-CN: 机器学习基础 · 反向传播 · 核方法
subtitle.en: Machine Learning Foundations · Backpropagation · Kernel Methods
